scope: Proposition 6.1 of the manuscript “Prescribed large-volume charges on threefolds with trivial canonical bundle” (preprints/Prescribed-large-volume-charges-on-threefolds-with-trivial-canonical-bundle-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 055 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ce978a67015704), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a smooth projective complex threefold, let H be very ample, and let B0 be a rational divisor class with H2B0 = 0. There are constants A > 0 and C ≥ 0, depending only on X, H, B0, such that, for every b ∈ R and every finite-slope νA,b-semistable object E ∈ BH,B0+bH with νA,b(E) = 0, zB(E) − A2 6 dB(E) ≤ C ( dB(E) − A|r(E)| ) , B = B0 + bH. (6.1) The same constants can be chosen for B0 and −B0.
